notes: One row per building TYPE, one generated scene per row: src/main/resources/com/openworld/world/buildings/<id>.tscn.

Sizes are in the kit's MODULES (quaternius_downtown_city: 1.82 m, the ken) and STOREYS (a row: 2.73 m, or 3.64 m with a band). The metres in `jp` are what the type is meant to read as, and tools/building_kit/layout_buildings.py refuses a type whose built size misses them by more than one module.
Front faces +Z, the origin is the footprint centre at ground level (BLENDER_CONVENTIONS.md, 'Asset').

floors: storey groups from the ground up. front/back/sides name a row in the kit's kit.json. doors: {side: [module index from the side's left end seen from outside]}; omitted = the middle module of the front on the ground floor.
ac_units: outdoor air-conditioner units hung on the named sides of the upper floors, every Nth module (a Japanese facade's most recognisable clutter). roof_units: that many on the roof.
examples: the kit's own pre-built buildings, re-scaled only. They are Boston/NYC, kept as filler and as a reference for the kit's look.
